title: Floor show at the EM Club — the dancer works the crowd
description: The same club on the same night, and the room is delighted: a dancer in a red sequined top and a long slit pink skirt moves through the audience while a soldier leans in with a mock-courtly grin and everyone around them laughs. At front left another soldier crouches with a camera and flash — a second photographer working the show. Checkered tablecloths, beverage cans, crew cuts and fatigues; the clarinetist plays on at right. "Entertainment at the EM Club in Ton Suhn Nhut. About 50 yards from my hooch."
researchNotes: Captioned with VN-0030 on 2026-09-05 (giscus-vn-0031-c18308463.json). The crouching photographer at front left is worth remembering: at least two cameras were working that night, so some of the club frames in the collection may not be Larry's own exposures — a question for another sitting, asked open. Several name tapes in the front row are sharp enough to try under magnification; none has been read, and no name should be suggested to Larry.
